summary.caption: A perfectly symmetrical, eye-level cinematic key frame from a dark fantasy film, shot on a 50mm lens with strict single-point central perspective. The setting is a colossal EMPTY circular void of a chamber: nothing but near-black blue-grey fog and darkness receding in every direction, no walls, no floor detail, no furniture, no architecture, no windows. At the EXACT GEOMETRIC CENTER of the frame hangs ONE humanoid monster, fully visible, front-facing, arms pulled wide open and legs slightly spread, suspended in mid-air with no support. Dozens of heavy iron chains radiate outward from its body in every direction like the spokes of a wheel, all perfectly straight and pulled taut, converging on the figure from beyond all four edges and all four corners of the frame; each chain reads as one clean high-contrast line against the dark void with thick interlocking links, no sag, no curve, no crossing, no knots. A single hard cold-white shaft of light falls from directly above onto the figure, rim-lighting the chains, with faint rust-red reflections on the iron. Deep blacks, generous heavy negative space on all sides, volumetric haze, restrained palette of charcoal, cold white and oxidized iron, fine film grain, subtle vignette. Readable graphic silhouette, oppressive stillness, immense empty space around one centered prisoner. STRUCTURE RULE: exactly ONE creature, exactly ONE kind of repeating element (straight taut chains), and an otherwise completely EMPTY background. Chains are straight radial lines only; absolutely no drooping loops, no tangled webs, no spider webs, no vines, no tentacles, no ropes, no thin needle rods, no pillars, no extra small figures. No text, no watermark, no logos.

items.label: character
items.caption: THE single central figure: one towering humanoid monster, perfectly centered and front-facing, arms stretched straight out to both sides and legs slightly parted, held motionless in mid-air. Broad heavy shoulders, a thick torso and long powerful limbs in the proportions of a giant human; dark charcoal stone-like hide with a few large smooth bone plates across the chest and shoulders; a small featureless head with one narrow vertical glowing fissure instead of a face, and two short thick curved horns. Simple large readable masses, no intricate ornament, no small spikes, no extra limbs, no second head. Cold white top light carves a sharp silhouette, deep shadow inside the body, faint rust-red edge reflections where the chains meet the wrists and ankles.

items.label: object
items.caption: A fan of 6 to 8 heavy iron chains, every one perfectly straight and stretched taut, radiating inward from the UPPER-LEFT edge and corner of the frame toward the central figure's outstretched left arm and left shoulder. Thick clearly readable interlocking links, slight perspective convergence, high-contrast dark silhouettes with thin cold highlights. Straight radial lines only: no sagging, no curves, no crossing, no tangles, no ropes, no vines, no thin wires.
